summary.business_type: UK home-decor content blog (Pinterest-driven, Astro on Vercel)
top_findings: kitchen-on-a-budget-uk has only cluster-internal links (~13/64 posts), no cross-cluster coverage despite ~48% of GSC impressions
No homepage FAQPage schema (present on all 58 checked blog posts)
15+ of 64 post titles exceed ~70 displayed characters, worst case 85 chars
quick_wins: Add CSP header to vercel.json headers block
Add 1-2 contextual links to kitchen-on-a-budget-uk in bedroom/living-room/seasonal posts
Copy homepage FAQPage schema pattern from BlogPost.astro/FAQ.astro
Trim titles on the 5 worst offenders (afrobohemian-decor-ideas-uk, unfitted-kitchen-ideas-uk, renter-friendly-gallery-wall-ideas-uk, funhaus-decor-ideas-uk, budget-kitchen-cabinet-makeover-uk)
Add a basic llms.txt at site root

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt allows all agents, correct sitemap-index.xml reference
Per-post real lastmod dates in sitemap (astro.config.mjs reads dateModified frontmatter)
HTTPS + HSTS enforced, Vercel edge caching
Consistent trailing slashes, clean redirect map for consolidated posts

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: vercel.json headers block includes X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy but no CSP entry.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header to vercel.json, starting permissive (allow GTM/GA, Google Fonts, self) then tighten.

findings.title: Conventional /sitemap.xml path returns the site's 404 page (HTTP 200, noindex) instead of the real sitemap
findings.description: The real sitemap is at /sitemap-index.xml per robots.txt and works correctly; /sitemap.xml is unused and silently serves the custom 404 page.
findings.recommendation: No functional fix needed since robots.txt correctly points to sitemap-index.xml; just be aware when submitting to tools/engines that assume the default path.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 58/64 posts confirmed with unique, specific meta descriptions (UK retailer/price detail)
No duplicate meta descriptions found in sample
Active cannibalization cleanup discipline (5 documented redirects/merges)

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Proper H1/H2 heading hierarchy per post

findings.title: Over-length page titles
findings.description: 15+ of 64 posts have displayed titles (incl. site-name suffix) over 70 characters; worst is 85 chars (afrobohemian-decor-ideas-uk).
findings.recommendation: Shorten to <=60 chars pre-suffix where possible, prioritizing worst offenders.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: FAQPage schema on 58/58 checked blog posts
BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList, Person, Organization, ImageObject schema present on posts

findings.title: No FAQPage schema on homepage
findings.description: Homepage JSON-LD only has Organization + WebSite types.
findings.recommendation: Add homepage FAQ content + FAQPage schema, reusing the existing per-post pattern.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Inlined stylesheets (build.inlineStylesheets: 'always') to cut render-blocking CSS
Postbuild script injects image width/height to prevent CLS

findings.title: No independent CWV/Lighthouse measurement in this pass
findings.description: Scoping limitation -- structural positives observed in code but not lab-tested.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights / CrUX once Google API access is confirmed for this property.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: FAQPage Q&A schema on every post is directly extractable by AI answer engines

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Add a basic llms.txt listing site purpose, categories, and sitemap link.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP conversion pipeline with responsive srcset/sizes on card thumbnails
loading=lazy applied site-wide on below-fold images; hero images correctly eager+fetchpriority=high
Width/height attributes patched via postbuild script

findings.title: Alt-text not exhaustively audited
findings.description: Spot-checked posts had descriptive, keyword-relevant alt text; not verified across all 64 posts.
findings.recommendation: Run a full alt-text pass as a backlog item.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add cross-cluster internal links to kitchen-on-a-budget-uk from bedroom/living-room/seasonal posts

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Shorten over-length titles (5 worst offenders first)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Run Lighthouse/CrUX once Google API access confirmed
